sentences.en: I'm David Marchese.

sentences.en: Lady Gaga is undoubtedly one of pop culture's great shapeshifters.
sentences.zh: Lady Gaga无疑是流行文化中最伟大的变色龙之一。

sentences.en: She's tried on with great success a whole range of different musical styles from the dance pop of her earliest albums like The Fame to the country rock of Joanne
sentences.zh: 她曾非常成功地尝试过各种不同的音乐风格，从她早期专辑（如《The Fame》）的舞曲流行乐，到《Joanne》的乡村摇滚。

sentences.en: Hear my sinners pray To her albums of jazzy duets with the great crooner Tony Bennett
sentences.zh: 听我的罪人们祈祷吧，还有她与伟大的抒情歌手托尼·班内特合作的爵士二重唱专辑。

sentences.en: Who's prepared to pay the price For a drip for sale So when I heard that Gaga's new album, Mayhem, was a return to the pop sounds of her early work,
sentences.zh: 谁准备好付出代价，为了待售的滴漏咖啡，所以当我听说Gaga的新专辑《Mayhem》回归了她早期作品的流行曲风时，

sentences.en: I wondered why a master of reinvention would be making that move.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇为什么一位重塑大师会做出这样的举动。

sentences.en: Was it a back-to-the-basics turn?
sentences.zh: 这是回归本源的转变吗？

sentences.en: Nostalgia play?
sentences.zh: 怀旧之作？

sentences.en: Hey, was Lady Gaga revisiting her own earlier style meant to be some sort of meta comment on what it means to be Lady Gaga?
sentences.zh: 嘿，Lady Gaga重拾她早期的风格，是想对“成为Lady Gaga”意味着什么进行某种元评论吗？

sentences.en: But as she explained it, the answer, in a way, is all of the above.
sentences.zh: 但正如她所解释的那样，答案在某种程度上包含了以上所有内容。

sentences.en: She and I talked about that new album, as well as how her relationship with her fiancé helped shape its music.
sentences.zh: 她和我聊了那张新专辑，以及她与未婚夫的关系如何塑造了其中的音乐。

sentences.en: And we talked, too, about the loneliness of fame and how it's taken her 20 years to learn how to be a boss.
sentences.zh: 我们也聊到了成名的孤独感，以及她花了20年才学会如何成为老板。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Lady Gaga.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与Lady Gaga的对话。

sentences.en: Hi, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 我也很好。

sentences.en: It's nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Thank you for taking the time to do this.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你抽出时间来做这次访谈。

sentences.en: Yes, it's nice to meet you, too.
sentences.zh: 是的，我也很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: I'm very happy to be doing this.
sentences.zh: 我非常乐意做这件事。

sentences.en: I'm just making sure all my devices are off.
sentences.zh: 我只是在确认我所有的设备都关掉了。

sentences.en: Okay, everything's off.
sentences.zh: 好了，一切都关掉了。

sentences.en: So, in an announcement that I saw for Mayhem, it must have been on social media somewhere, you referred to your fear of going back to the pop music that your earliest fans love.
sentences.zh: 那么，我在《Mayhem》的公告中看到——一定是在社交媒体上的某个地方——你提到了你对回归早期粉丝所喜爱的流行音乐的恐惧。

sentences.en: Why is that something you were scared of?
sentences.zh: 为什么你会害怕这一点？

sentences.en: You know, I lived in New York and grew up here my whole life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我住在纽约，我的一生都在这里成长。

sentences.en: And I made my artistic way living on the Lower East Side, starting around 17 years old, and really kind of worked the New York music scene as much as I could.
sentences.zh: 我从17岁左右开始在下东区开启了我的艺术之路，并尽可能地在纽约音乐圈摸爬滚打。

sentences.en: And ultimately, that landed me into making The Fame, which was my first studio album.
sentences.zh: 最终，这让我制作了我的第一张录音室专辑《The Fame》。

sentences.en: And, you know, that music came out of the culture of people that I was sort of living with.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那张音乐源于我当时生活圈子的文化。

sentences.en: At the time, downtown, I was surrounded by musicians, photographers, artists, club promoters, people that lived and breathed art for a living.
sentences.zh: 那时在市中心，我身边都是音乐家、摄影师、艺术家、俱乐部推广人，那些以艺术为生、呼吸着艺术气息的人。

sentences.en: It was a community of support.
sentences.zh: 那是一个相互支持的社区。

sentences.en: And I think one of the reasons I was afraid is I was so far away now from that community.
sentences.zh: 我想我害怕的原因之一是，我现在离那个社区太远了。

sentences.en: And not having my community was, you know, was difficult.
sentences.zh: 失去了我的社区，你知道，这很困难。

sentences.en: And I also think I was afraid to return to something that my fans fell in love with early because it felt very far away.
sentences.zh: 我也觉得我害怕回到粉丝们早期爱上的东西，因为它感觉非常遥远。

sentences.en: And because it also felt like maybe I would be just like recycling something that I'd done before.
sentences.zh: 而且也感觉好像我只是在回收我以前做过的东西。

sentences.en: But ultimately, I decided I really wanted to do it.
sentences.zh: 但最终，我决定我真的想这么做。

sentences.en: And that this sonic style and sonic aesthetic really did belong to me.
sentences.zh: 这种声音风格和审美确实属于我。

sentences.en: And it was something that I created.
sentences.zh: 这是我创造的东西。

sentences.en: And that was part of the joy of making the album.
sentences.zh: 这也是制作这张专辑的乐趣所在。

sentences.en: How do you characterize that sound for people?
sentences.zh: 你如何向人们描述那种声音？

sentences.en: I think that my sound is like an amalgamation of all the music that helped me fall in love with music.
sentences.zh: 我认为我的声音就像是我所有让我爱上音乐的音乐的融合体。

sentences.en: It's got classic rock in it.
sentences.zh: 它有经典摇滚的元素。

sentences.en: It has disco in it.
sentences.zh: 它有迪斯科的元素。

sentences.en: It has electronic music in it, 80s synth.
sentences.zh: 它有电子音乐的元素，80年代的合成器。

sentences.en: It's sort of like all of these memories of music.
sentences.zh: 它就像是所有这些音乐记忆的集合。

sentences.en: Something that we did on the album is like we would take the bass, play it live,
sentences.zh: 我们在专辑中做的一件事是，我们会录下贝斯，现场演奏，

sentences.en: and then we would actually run it through the analog synths to see how it would sound after guitar parts
sentences.zh: 然后我们实际上会把它通过模拟合成器，看看在吉他部分之后听起来会怎样，

sentences.en: that would be like indicative of the way Prince would play it or the way David Bowie would play it.
sentences.zh: 那些吉他部分会像王子（Prince）或大卫·鲍伊（David Bowie）演奏的方式。

sentences.en: I would say it's sort of like picking and choosing my favorite fragments of songs that I love throughout my childhood
sentences.zh: 我会说这就像是挑选和选择我在整个童年时期喜爱的歌曲片段，

sentences.en: and so many different kinds of artists with so many different genres.
sentences.zh: 以及来自不同流派的各种各样的艺术家。

sentences.en: And to me, that is my music.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这就是我的音乐。

sentences.en: It's everything I love about music, but it's all in one place.
sentences.zh: 它包含了我对音乐所热爱的一切，但都汇集在一个地方。

sentences.en: And I didn't always do that.
sentences.zh: 我并不总是这样做。

sentences.en: I sometimes in my records decided, okay, I'm going to make my version of a country record.
sentences.zh: 我有时在唱片中会决定，好吧，我要制作属于我的乡村唱片版本。

sentences.en: Like Joanne.
sentences.zh: 比如《Joanne》。

sentences.en: Like Joanne, right?
sentences.zh: 就像《Joanne》，对吧？

sentences.en: And Neil Young was making a record right across the way from me in the same studio.
sentences.zh: 当时尼尔·杨（Neil Young）就在我隔壁的同一个录音室里制作唱片。

sentences.en: And then I would like, you know, listen to Harvest Moon and like Daydream.
sentences.zh: 然后我会，你知道，听《Harvest Moon》之类的歌，像是在做白日梦。

sentences.en: And then I would write a song like Joanne.
sentences.zh: 然后我就会写出像《Joanne》这样的歌。

sentences.en: But those records, I think the way that I was sort of like bridled to think about women in music,
sentences.zh: 但那些唱片，我认为我当时被那种关于女性在音乐中应该如何思考的观念所束缚，

sentences.en: you know, they talk to you a lot about like your look and what the aesthetic is for the album and like the brand of the music.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们会跟你谈论很多关于你的外表、专辑的审美以及音乐的品牌。

sentences.en: And that at some point started to affect the way I made music.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上开始影响我制作音乐的方式。

sentences.en: And I didn't do that.
sentences.zh: 而我并没有那样做。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是吗。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: Well, you know, like with Joanne, I was like, okay, well, since I'm going to do this like country folk thing, now I'm going to make sure that each song fits into that theme.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，就像《Joanne》那样，我当时想，好吧，既然我要做这种乡村民谣风格，那我就要确保每一首歌都符合那个主题。

sentences.en: Whereas with Mayhem, I didn't do that.
sentences.zh: 而《Mayhem》则不同，我没有那样做。

sentences.en: With Mayhem, I let each song speak its own language.
sentences.zh: 在《Mayhem》中，我让每一首歌都诉说它自己的语言。

sentences.en: And that like chaos that I have maybe always felt criticized for, I celebrated instead.
sentences.zh: 那种我可能一直被批评的混乱，我反而去赞美它。

sentences.en: And when you said there were ways in which you sort of felt bridled in the way that people thought about women in pop music, what did you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 当你提到你感到在人们对流行音乐中女性的看法上受到束缚时，你是指什么？

sentences.en: And it's just the way they talk to you about, you know, who you are.
sentences.zh: 这只是他们谈论你是谁的方式。

sentences.en: When I, you know, I had my own kind of image when I moved to Hollywood and was playing my music for Interscope for the first time.
sentences.zh: 当我，你知道，当我搬到好莱坞并第一次为Interscope唱片公司演奏我的音乐时，我有我自己的形象。

sentences.en: And, you know, they have conversations with you about like, what's your look going to be?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们会和你谈论，比如，你的造型会是什么样？

sentences.en: And, you know, you're sort of thinking like, it's going to be me, you know?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你心里想的是，这会是我自己，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Well, how are you going to dress?
sentences.zh: 那么你打算穿什么？

sentences.en: Well, I'm going to wear what I usually wear when I'm on stage performing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我会穿我平时在舞台上表演时穿的衣服。

sentences.en: And it's just the way they sort of introduce you to start thinking about it as a business as opposed to a performance.
sentences.zh: 这只是他们引导你开始将其视为一种生意而不是表演的方式。

sentences.en: So I think a lot of my career in a way was like a retaliation against that.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我的职业生涯在某种程度上是对那种观念的报复。

sentences.en: I mean, it's no secret that I loved to make waves with my stage performances and my fashion.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我喜欢用我的舞台表演和时尚来制造轰动，这已经不是什么秘密了。

sentences.en: But yeah, I think what I was trying to say was that like that way of thinking kind of made its way at some point into the way I approached music.
sentences.zh: 但是的，我想我要说的是，那种思维方式在某种程度上影响了我对待音乐的方式。

sentences.en: And I had to kind of fight it.
sentences.zh: 我不得不去对抗它。

sentences.en: Were there ways in which you felt like you were in an exploitative relationship?
sentences.zh: 你是否曾感到自己处于一种剥削性的关系中？

sentences.en: You know, were there ever times that I felt like I was being exploited or in an exploit?
sentences.zh: 你知道，有没有那么几次我觉得自己被剥削了，或者处于剥削之中？

sentences.en: Or just treated as a commodity?
sentences.zh: 或者仅仅是被当作一种商品对待？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: A hundred percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之百。

sentences.en: I mean, I think the, what's interesting is I always feel nervous to talk about this because I'm like, I always feel like I want to say that I'm extremely grateful for the
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为有趣的是，我总是对谈论这个感到紧张，因为我总是觉得我想说，我非常感激我所拥有的

sentences.en: career that I've had and all the blessings that have come into my life.
sentences.zh: 职业生涯，以及我生命中所有的福分。

sentences.en: And I also can say with, you know, a lot of honesty and truth that
sentences.zh: 我也能非常诚实和真实地说，

sentences.en: being in the music industry since I was a teenager, like some of it is what you can, like how much you can stand.
sentences.zh: 从十几岁起就进入音乐行业，有些事情取决于你能承受多少。

sentences.en: It's like how much you are willing to give away of yourself.
sentences.zh: 这就像你愿意放弃多少自我。

sentences.en: Um, you know, there were like years and years at a time when, um, the normal routine of daily life just floats, this goes away.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，有几年时间，日常生活的正常节奏就消失了。

sentences.en: Um, things like eating at the dinner table with your family is just, it just never happens anymore.
sentences.zh: 嗯，像和家人在餐桌上吃饭这样的事情，就再也不会发生了。

sentences.en: And, um, being in a room by yourself never happens anymore.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，独自待在一个房间里也再也不会发生了。

sentences.en: Um, being sort of carted around, told where to go, um, I'm sure that must sound like peculiar to people because they see you on top of the world and they think you're the boss.
sentences.zh: 嗯，被到处带走，被告知去哪里，嗯，我肯定这听起来很奇怪，因为人们看到你站在世界之巅，认为你是老板。

sentences.en: But as a woman in music, I would say it took me 20 years to become the boss.
sentences.zh: 但作为一名音乐界的女性，我会说我花了20年才成为老板。

sentences.en: And I am now.
sentences.zh: 我现在是了。

sentences.en: And that's thanks to having wonderful people around me and including my partner, Michael.
sentences.zh: 这要归功于我身边有很棒的人，包括我的伴侣迈克尔。

sentences.en: Um, he really helped me become the boss and, uh, but, but no, I, I was not always the boss, but I, I was the boss of my music.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他真的帮助我成为了老板，呃，但是，不，我并不总是老板，但我，我是我音乐的老板。

sentences.en: I was the boss of my art.
sentences.zh: 我是我艺术的老板。

sentences.en: And that was kind of the only thing, you know, because if, if you strike at the, at the art, then no one gets what they want from you.
sentences.zh: 那是唯一的东西，你知道，因为如果你攻击艺术，那么没有人能从你这里得到他们想要的。

sentences.en: But yeah, it's, it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 但是的，这很有趣。

sentences.en: I, I like wrestle with this, how to talk about it because yeah, I just, I want to want to
sentences.zh: 我，我纠结于如何谈论这个，因为是的，我只是，我想承认我生命中所有的福分，同时也，你知道，为这个行业中的女性发声，

sentences.en: acknowledge all the blessings in my life while also, you know, speaking up for women in this
sentences.zh: 你知道，你知道，女性，当我们在音乐行业工作时，当我们年轻时，

sentences.en: industry that, you know, you know, women, when we're working in the music business, when we're
sentences.zh: 你知道，关于谁可以成为制作人是没有法律规定的，而且，如果他们喜欢，他们不会经过任何人的审查。

sentences.en: young, you know that there's like no laws around like who can be a producer and like, if they like, they're not vetted by anyone.
sentences.zh: 所以当你17岁时，嗯，你被邀请进录音室，你几乎没有任何保护。

sentences.en: So like when you're 17 years old, um, and you are invited into a studio, like you have like no protection at all.
sentences.zh: 就像你不知道你要去哪里。

sentences.en: Like you don't know where you're going.
sentences.zh: 除了和你一起工作的人之外，房间里可能甚至没有其他成年人。

sentences.en: There's your, you may not even have an adult in the room with you other than the person that you're working with.
sentences.zh: 这只是，这，这不是最安全的行业。

sentences.en: It's just, it's, it's not the safest industry.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你对查佩尔·罗恩（Chappell Roan）在格莱美奖上的演讲有什么看法，她谈到了，呃，唱片公司在某种程度上没有用医疗保险或生活工资来支持艺术家，

sentences.en: I'm curious what you made of Chapel Rhone's speech at the Grammys where she talked about, uh, sort of the ways in which their record labels are not supporting the artists with,
sentences.zh: 你知道。

sentences.en: you know, healthcare or living wage.
sentences.zh: 我认为她是一位出色的艺术家。

sentences.en: I think she's a wonderful artiSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为查佩尔·罗恩是在说真话，她有勇气这样做。

sentences.en: I think Chapel Rhone is like speaking the truth and she is courageous to do so.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们应该，对我来说，我只是想支持她。

sentences.en: And I think we should, for me, I just want to be supportive of her.
sentences.zh: 我看着她所做和所说的一切，心想，天哪，我年轻的时候应该，我应该更勇敢地为自己挺身而出，因为我，我希望这能为她带来

sentences.en: And I look at what she's been doing and saying and think like, man, I should have, I should have like stood up for myself more when I was younger because I, I hope that will bring
sentences.zh: 更多的空间，并在她的职业生涯中为她设定更多的界限，去拥有她想要的职业生涯。

sentences.en: more space for her and more boundaries for her in her career to, to have the career that she wants.
sentences.zh: 我认为女性表达自己的想法是一件强大的事情。

sentences.en: I think a woman speaking their mind is a powerful thing.
sentences.zh: 我真的很高兴她，她那样做了。

sentences.en: And I was really happy that she, that she did that.
sentences.zh: 还有你的伴侣，迈克尔·波兰斯基（Michael Polanski）。

sentences.en: And your partner, Michael Polanski.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 他是这张专辑的执行制作人。

sentences.en: He's an executive producer on the album.
sentences.zh: 是的，他是。

sentences.en: Yes, he is.
sentences.zh: 你能跟我谈谈这个角色对他来说意味着什么吗？

sentences.en: Can you just sort of talk to me about how that role played out for him?
sentences.zh: 比如他对音乐有什么影响？

sentences.en: Like what impact does he have on, on the music?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我工作的时候，迈克尔每天都在录音室里陪着我。

sentences.en: I mean, Michael was in the studio like every single day with me while I was working.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他监督了制作唱片、完成唱片的整个过程，你知道，帮助我塑造唱片的声音，呃，在创意上让我相信自己。

sentences.en: Um, he oversaw the whole process of making the record, completing it, you know, helping me to shape the, the sound of the record, uh, creatively to trust myself.
sentences.zh: 这非常善良，呃，美好。

sentences.en: It was incredibly like kind and, uh, beautiful.
sentences.zh: 这和你伴侣一起做的事情真是太棒了，你知道吗？

sentences.en: It was like an amazing thing to do with your partner, you know?
sentences.zh: 因为当，当我开始怀疑自己时，没有人比他更能指出这一点。

sentences.en: Cause when, when I start to doubt myself, like there is nobody that's going to call me on it better than he is.
sentences.zh: 你有例子吗？

sentences.en: Do you have an example?
sentences.zh: 是的，实际上有一次我差点把整张专辑变成一张垃圾摇滚（grunge）唱片。

sentences.en: Yeah, actually there was like one point where I almost turned the whole album into like a grunge record.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，够了。

sentences.en: And he was like, okay, well, there's enough.
sentences.zh: 专辑里已经有很多垃圾摇滚元素了，但那是在我做完《Perfect Celebrity》那首歌之后。

sentences.en: There's like plenty of grunge on the album, but it was right after I did, um, Perfect
sentences.zh: 那首歌。

sentences.en: Celebrity, that song.
sentences.zh: 那首歌。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, like now everything should be this.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，噢，现在一切都该是这样了。

sentences.en: And he was like, he said, but there's so much other amazing music that you've made and it's all you.
sentences.zh: 他说，但他又说，你创作过那么多其他精彩的音乐，那才是真正的你。

sentences.en: Like, you don't have to try to be something.
sentences.zh: 就像，你不必刻意去成为什么人。

sentences.en: I thought that was really, um, astute and I was happy it happened because very often I will like run with my crazy idea and then look back on it and sometimes regret that change.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的很……嗯，敏锐。我很高兴发生了这件事，因为我经常会顺着自己疯狂的想法去做，回头看时有时会后悔当初的改变。

sentences.en: So, um, yeah, it was, it was really cool.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，是的，这真的很酷。

sentences.en: I could imagine that relationships are tricky for someone in your position because, you know,
sentences.zh: 我能想象，对于你这样地位的人来说，人际关系是很棘手的，因为，你知道，

sentences.en: you might have questions about someone else's, um, you know, whether or not their feelings are genuine or if they have ulterior motives or, you know, just sort of, if they really
sentences.zh: 你可能会对别人产生疑问，嗯，你知道，怀疑他们的感情是否真诚，或者他们是否有不可告人的动机，或者，你知道，只是，他们是否真的

sentences.en: want to be with you or their idea of who you are.
sentences.zh: 想和你在一起，还是仅仅因为他们心目中对你的那种想象。

sentences.en: How did you realize that like Michael was genuine?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么意识到迈克尔是真诚的呢？

sentences.en: How did I know Michael was genuine?
sentences.zh: 我是怎么知道迈克尔是真诚的？

sentences.en: I mean, from the moment that I met Michael, he had the most warm and kind disposition of like mostly anyone that I had maybe met my whole life.
sentences.zh: 我是说，从我见到迈克尔的那一刻起，他就有种我这辈子见过的人里最温暖、最善良的性情。

sentences.en: And yes, he was impressive.
sentences.zh: 是的，他很令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: He had like all these businesses that he was running.
sentences.zh: 他经营着各种各样的生意。

sentences.en: And, um, um, but the thing I cared about the most was like, he, he like wanted to know about my family.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，嗯，但我最在乎的是，他，他想了解我的家人。

sentences.en: No, it's okay.
sentences.zh: 不，没关系。

sentences.en: Well, I'm sorry to cry on a podcast because no one can see you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我很抱歉在播客里哭，因为没人能看见你。

sentences.en: It is you.
sentences.zh: 那就是你。

sentences.en: Um, he was, he just, um, he wanted to be my friend.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他只是，嗯，他想成为我的朋友。

sentences.en: He wanted to be my friend and, um, it was just, uh, it was, um, really special.
sentences.zh: 他想成为我的朋友，而且，嗯，这真的，呃，这真的，嗯，非常特别。

sentences.en: I mean, I guess what I'm trying to say is I knew Michael was genuine because he wanted to be my friend.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我想表达的是，我知道迈克尔是真诚的，因为他想成为我的朋友。

sentences.en: Um, he wasn't asking to go to things with me or, um, like, I don't know how to explain it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他不是为了让我陪他去参加什么活动，或者，嗯，我不知道该怎么解释。

sentences.en: How do you explain, how do you explain the thing that people do that's hard?
sentences.zh: 你该怎么解释，怎么解释人们做的那种困难的事情？

sentences.en: Um, he didn't, he didn't want to do any of the things that the other people wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他没有，他不想做其他人想做的那些事。

sentences.en: He, he wanted to take walks with me.
sentences.zh: 他，他只想和我一起散步。

sentences.en: Um, he took me rock climbing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他带我去攀岩。

sentences.en: Well, cause I, I also had like a, a pain condition, um, that I still have, but, uh, you know, he,
sentences.zh: 好吧，因为我，我当时也有，一种，一种疼痛的病症，嗯，我现在还有，但是，呃，你知道，他，

sentences.en: he had this belief that I could get better and he really inspired me to have more hope about it.
sentences.zh: 他坚信我会好起来，他真的激励了我，让我对康复有了更多希望。

sentences.en: So, and you know, the truth is Michael really is like not a fan of the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，事实是迈克尔真的不喜欢聚光灯。

sentences.en: It's, he had a really hard time with the cameras when we first started dating and he kind of got comfortable with it for me so that we could do it together.
sentences.zh: 这，我们刚开始约会时，他对镜头感到非常不自在，但他为了我慢慢适应了，这样我们就能一起面对了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I guess I know Michael's genuine because, um, he's my friend.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我想我知道迈克尔是真诚的，因为，嗯，他是我的朋友。

sentences.en: I'm very, I'm, you know, I hope this doesn't sound trite.
sentences.zh: 我非常，我，你知道，我希望这听起来不陈腐。

sentences.en: I don't mean it trite.
sentences.zh: 我不是那个意思。

sentences.en: I'm very glad that you found that.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴你找到了那份感情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I'm glad I found it too.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴我找到了。

sentences.en: It was really hard not having it, you know, it was, it's like not a good feeling to have so much trouble making friends.
sentences.zh: 没有它的时候真的很难，你知道，那，那种交朋友遇到这么多困难的感觉真的很不好。

sentences.en: Um, that was really hard for me over the course of my career.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这在我的职业生涯中真的让我很难受。

sentences.en: You know, being actually friends with somebody is like, it's like a very specific thing, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，和某人真正成为朋友，这是一种，这是一种非常特别的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: It's like when you can sit in a room together and not talk and read and you can take long walks and talk about, you know, your family.
sentences.zh: 就像你们可以坐在同一个房间里，不说话，各自看书，或者一起去散长步，聊聊，你知道，你的家人。

sentences.en: Um, you can obsess over a new recipe and, uh, go to the grocery store and go make it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你们可以一起钻研一个新食谱，呃，去杂货店买齐材料，然后把它做出来。

sentences.en: Like there's, there's, it's, friendship is not about like, um, I don't think it should be transactional, but I think I just was around a lot of that all the time.
sentences.zh: 就像，有，有，友谊不是关于，嗯，我不认为它应该是交易性的，但我认为我一直以来都被这种关系包围着。

sentences.en: I was kind of like starved for it.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点像，渴望那种纯粹的友谊。

sentences.en: Um, so, um, it was, it's a big blessing that I, you know, I met someone that was, you know, not like that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，嗯，能遇到一个不是那样的人，真的是，你知道，一个巨大的福气。

sentences.en: And, um, and it's good for the music too, you know, I could imagine that the sort of feeling of contentment might be a feeling that artists can mistrust because of the idea
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，这对音乐也有好处，你知道，我能想象那种满足感可能是艺术家们会怀疑的一种感觉，因为人们认为

sentences.en: that, um, you know, great art is created under, um, sort of tense circumstances, or I'm sure you, you are aware of, of, uh, albums that people love.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，伟大的艺术是在，嗯，某种紧张的环境下创作出来的，或者我相信你，你一定知道，那些人们喜爱的专辑。

sentences.en: And part of the legend of them is that they were recorded when the artist was struggling.
sentences.zh: 它们传奇的一部分就是它们是在艺术家处于挣扎时期录制的。

sentences.en: Like you're a David Bowie fan, right?
sentences.zh: 就像你是大卫·鲍伊的粉丝，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, and it's like, everyone knows he made station to station or whatever, when he was like, thought he was being chased by witches cause he was out of his mind on cocaine and
sentences.zh: 你知道，每个人都知道他制作《Station to Station》或者其他什么的时候，他以为自己被女巫追赶，因为他当时吸食可卡因神志不清，

sentences.en: only eating hot peppers and drinking milk.
sentences.zh: 只吃辣椒，喝牛奶。

sentences.en: And like his life was insane.
sentences.zh: 他的生活简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: He was probably pretty unhappy, but he did make a great album, but we don't have as many cultural legends about when happy artists make great art.
sentences.zh: 他当时可能很不快乐，但他确实做出了伟大的专辑，但我们关于快乐的艺术家创作伟大艺术的文化传奇却没那么多。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the lore, right?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这就是传说，对吧？

sentences.en: And some, and on some of it's truth, right?
sentences.zh: 而且有些，有些确实是真的，对吧？

sentences.en: That artists make, people say artists make their best work when we're tortured, but I would really like to do away with that.
sentences.zh: 人们说艺术家在受折磨时创作出最好的作品，但我真的想摒弃这种说法。

sentences.en: Actually, I think it's super unhealthy for like the world.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为这对世界来说非常不健康。

sentences.en: And I think I've made some of my best work and I'm, I'm happy and healthy.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我已经创作出了一些最好的作品，而我，我是快乐且健康的。

sentences.en: And because I have all my faculties as a musician, I also think that like romanticizing sick artists, it like perpetuates this thing that's super negative.
sentences.zh: 因为我作为音乐人拥有了所有的能力，我也认为浪漫化那些生病的艺术家，这会延续一种非常负面的东西。

sentences.en: And especially for women, I want women to feel like they can be healthy and be happy that, that we will celebrate them in their health.
sentences.zh: 尤其是对女性而言，我希望女性觉得她们可以保持健康和快乐，我们也会赞美她们的健康状态。

sentences.en: But you're right.
sentences.zh: 但你是对的。

sentences.en: That is definitely a thing.
sentences.zh: 那确实是一种现象。

sentences.en: Um, I feel really grateful that I'm like still here, you know, I definitely think that my life could have been very different.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我真的很感激我还能在这里，你知道，我绝对认为我的人生本可能会非常不同。

sentences.en: Maybe over five years ago, I think I was in a really dark place and I wouldn't say I made my best music during that time at all.
sentences.zh: 也许在五年前，我想我处于一个非常黑暗的境地，我不会说我在那段时间创作出了我最好的音乐。

sentences.en: So for what it's worth coming from me, I'm not the only artist that ever lived, but from my experience, the hardest times in my life were not the best music I ever made.
sentences.zh: 所以，就我而言，虽然我不是世界上唯一的艺术家，但根据我的经验，我生命中最艰难的时刻并不是我创作出最好音乐的时候。

sentences.en: Were there times where you felt like you didn't make something that was authentic to yourself?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么时候你觉得你创作的东西对自己来说不够真实？

sentences.en: I don't, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我，我不知道。

sentences.en: Sometimes, yeah, sometimes maybe like a song here or there, maybe I was feeling deeply insecure or, um, you know, I think chromatica was really hard for me.
sentences.zh: 有时，是的，有时可能是一两首歌，也许我当时感到非常不安，或者，嗯，你知道，我觉得《Chromatica》对我来说真的很难。

sentences.en: That was a very authentic dance record that I'm very proud of.
sentences.zh: 那是一张非常真实的舞曲唱片，我为此感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: And I loved working on that, but it was just a hard time in my life.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢制作那张专辑，但那是我生命中一段艰难的时期。

sentences.en: I think it's hard to feel deeply authentic when you don't feel well.
sentences.zh: 我认为当你感觉不好的时候，很难感到真正的真实。

sentences.en: Cause like, you can't like feel the wind at your back and I just wasn't feeling well.
sentences.zh: 因为，就像，你无法感受到顺风顺水，而我当时感觉并不好。

sentences.en: So it was authentic to the time for sure.
sentences.zh: 所以那确实是那个时期的真实写照。

sentences.en: Um, I wrote all those songs, sang all those songs, but I, I think that in terms of, um,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我写了所有那些歌，唱了所有那些歌，但我，我认为就，嗯，

sentences.en: like being connected to my pure artistic source, I think that there were times when I was feeling healthier that I would probably say those felt more authentic to me.
sentences.zh: 就像与我纯粹的艺术源泉连接而言，我认为在我感觉更健康的时候，我可能会说那些作品对我来说更真实。

sentences.en: There are a lot of ways in which I think of your music as in a way, sort of a comment on authenticity.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，我认为你的音乐在某种程度上是对真实性的一种评论。

sentences.en: Have your ideas about what it means to be authentic changed over time?
sentences.zh: 你对“真实”意味着什么的看法随着时间改变了吗？

sentences.en: I think I definitely was like fascinated with artifice when I first started my musical career.
sentences.zh: 我想我刚开始音乐生涯时，确实对“虚构”非常着迷。

sentences.en: And I thought the use of artifice can be incredibly authentic.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为对“虚构”的使用也可以是非常真实的。

sentences.en: It's just the way that you do it.
sentences.zh: 这只是你处理它的方式而已。

sentences.en: Um, I think my understanding of authenticity is that what's changed for me is it has to be on my own terMs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为我对真实性的理解，对我来说改变的是，它必须按照我自己的方式。

sentences.en: It has to be something that I decide because I think for myself over the years, especially because I started out a career in commenting on artifice.
sentences.zh: 它必须是我决定的事情，因为我认为多年来我一直在为自己思考，特别是因为我的职业生涯始于对“虚构”的评论。

sentences.en: And then I sort of traveled into what's, you know, what some of my fans would even call like normcore with, uh, Joanne and, uh, a star is born.
sentences.zh: 然后我进入了，你知道，一些粉丝甚至称之为“Normcore”（极简主义）的领域，比如《Joanne》和《一个明星的诞生》。

sentences.en: I think there were some people that thought that that wasn't authentic.
sentences.zh: 我想有些人认为那不够真实。

sentences.en: So I think what I realized is I have to understand I, for me, I have to know my authenticity for myself and yeah, authenticity to me is a, um, is a committee of one.
sentences.zh: 所以我意识到我必须明白，对我来说，我必须为自己定义我的真实性，是的，对我来说，真实性是一个，嗯，是一个人的委员会。

sentences.en: You know, it's, if you, if you look at the history of pop music, like there's not a ton of people who don't end up becoming like, as they get older, don't end up becoming, you
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你，如果你看看流行音乐的历史，并没有多少人随着年龄增长，最终没有变成，

sentences.en: know, legacy acts or, or chasing trends or something like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，怀旧艺人，或者追逐潮流之类的人。

sentences.en: Are there people you look to and say like, oh, they forged a trail that looks comfortable for me to go down?
sentences.zh: 有没有你仰望的人，觉得他们开辟了一条让你觉得走起来很舒服的道路？

sentences.en: I mean, I think Tony Bennett forged the trail that means the most to me.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我认为托尼·班内特开辟的道路对我意义最重大。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, Tony always used to tell me, he used to say, just stick with quality kid.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道，托尼总是告诉我，他常说，坚持品质，孩子。

sentences.en: And that made me feel so happy and safe that if I leaned into my artistry, I didn't have to be afraid.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到非常快乐和安心，如果我专注于我的艺术造诣，我就不必害怕。

sentences.en: And, um, so that's like, I mean, that's a lot of what this album is for me is I just leaned into my musicianship hard, like really hard.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，所以这就是，我是说，这张专辑对我来说很大程度上就是我全身心地投入到我的音乐素养中，真的非常投入。

sentences.en: And I told myself, you know, whatever happens over the next 20 years, 30 years of your career,
sentences.zh: 我告诉自己，你知道，无论未来20年、30年的职业生涯发生什么，

sentences.en: you're always going to be a musician and you're always going to be an artist and you can always work at it.
sentences.zh: 你永远都是一名音乐人，你永远都是一名艺术家，你总能在这方面下功夫。

sentences.en: You can always do more of it.
sentences.zh: 你总能做得更多。

sentences.en: Um, but I, I think I've definitely like arrived at a place where, um, you know, achieving world domination into my nineties is like not exactly what makes me tick, you know?
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我，我想我确实已经到了一个阶段，嗯，你知道，在九十多岁时实现统治世界并不是我真正追求的，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And this idea of winning is, I don't know if that's synonymous necessarily always with great music.
sentences.zh: 而且这种“赢”的概念，我不知道它是否一定总是与伟大的音乐同义。

sentences.en: Do you feel like you, you might have a different attitude about the idea of winning if you hadn't already won in a sense?
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有在某种意义上“赢”过，你觉得你对“赢”这个概念的态度会不同吗？

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I ask myself that question pretty often, actually, like, how would I look at this differently?
sentences.zh: 我是说，我其实经常问自己这个问题，比如，我会如何以不同的方式看待这件事？

sentences.en: You know, how am I thinking about this the right way?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我该如何以正确的方式思考这个问题？

sentences.en: And, you know, there's just noise sometimes and pressure, but the person that puts the most pressure on me is me.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，有时会有噪音和压力，但给我施加最大压力的人是我自己。

sentences.en: Sometimes I have to warn myself to do something at 70%.
sentences.zh: 有时我不得不提醒自己，做到70%就可以了。

sentences.en: Like, don't go a hundred because a hundred is going to bang you up.
sentences.zh: 比如，别做到100%，因为100%会让你崩溃。

sentences.en: Like I'm getting ready for Coachella and I'm so, so excited, but I've definitely lost sleep like a whole bunch of nights.
sentences.zh: 就像我正在为科切拉音乐节做准备，我非常非常兴奋，但我确实已经好几个晚上失眠了。

sentences.en: And it's just because I want to do a great job and I'm really hard on myself and, you know, but it's, I love making people smile.
sentences.zh: 这只是因为我想做好，我对自己的要求非常严格，而且，你知道，但我喜欢让人们微笑。

sentences.en: Like if there's a time and a date where I've been slotted, like you could make the public smile from, you know, 11 p.m.
sentences.zh: 就像如果有一个时间段我被安排好了，比如你可以让公众从，你知道，晚上11点

sentences.en: until one in the morning, I really want to make it happen.
sentences.zh: 一直到凌晨一点感到快乐，我真的想实现它。

sentences.en: You know, I think of your music as celebrating difference, but I wouldn't say in the larger culture right now, it feels like difference is something that's being celebrated.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为你的音乐是在赞美差异，但我不会说在当今的大文化中，差异似乎是一个被赞美的东西。

sentences.en: Do you think about how your music fits into the larger culture that you're putting it out into?
sentences.zh: 你会思考你的音乐如何融入你所处的更广阔的文化中吗？

sentences.en: You know, I think that, um, people that are different are part of what reminds us all how to love and how to be strong.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为，嗯，与众不同的人是我们所有人学习如何去爱和如何坚强的部分原因。

sentences.en: And it makes me really sad that we live in this world where it's acceptable to hurt other people, to be powerful.
sentences.zh: 生活在这个为了获得权力而伤害他人是可以被接受的世界里，这让我感到非常难过。

sentences.en: But I think during times like these, we have to get louder.
sentences.zh: 但我认为在这样的时代，我们必须发出更大的声音。

sentences.en: And what I wish for people to know is that like, we can work together to be loud and we can work together to love each other.
sentences.zh: 我希望人们知道的是，我们可以共同努力去发声，我们可以共同努力去爱彼此。

sentences.en: And that like, just because dark people are winning, it doesn't mean that we are invisible or, um, that we are unimportant.
sentences.zh: 而且，仅仅因为黑暗的人正在获胜，并不意味着我们是隐形的，或者，嗯，我们是不重要的。

sentences.en: I'm thinking of the Grammys and, and when you accepted an award, I think you were the only artist who said something was explicitly in support of trans rights.
sentences.zh: 我想到格莱美奖，当你领奖时，我想你是唯一一位明确表示支持跨性别权利的艺术家。

sentences.en: Do you see your mission as an artist in 2025 is to, is there a political aspect to it?
sentences.zh: 你认为你作为2025年艺术家的使命是，它有政治层面吗？

sentences.en: I think there's just always been a political aspect to being in the public eye for me.
sentences.zh: 我认为对我来说，身处公众视野中一直都有政治层面。

sentences.en: Like, I'm not interested in being famous to stand for nothing at all.
sentences.zh: 就像，我对为了出名而什么都不支持不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Um, it's a privilege to stand with people that are so amazing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，能与如此了不起的人站在一起是一种荣幸。

sentences.en: I'm in awe of the trans community and I'm in awe of the LGBTQ plus community.
sentences.zh: 我敬佩跨性别群体，我也敬佩LGBTQ+群体。

sentences.en: And I have been since I was really young.
sentences.zh: 从我很小的时候起就是这样。

sentences.en: You know, and if you win an award, like you have 45 seconds to speak while the world is listening.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你赢得了一个奖项，你有45秒的时间在全世界聆听时发言。

sentences.en: I just wanted to say something that matters to people that I care about.
sentences.zh: 我只是想说一些对我在乎的人很重要的话。

sentences.en: You know, I'm not a trans person, but I, I know I try to imagine what it would feel like to wake up living in America and living in the world right now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不是跨性别者，但我，我知道我试着想象，生活在现在的美国和现在的世界里会是什么感觉。

sentences.en: And I just think being, being supportive, being kind, and, um, we can't just whisper about these things.
sentences.zh: 我只是认为，给予支持，保持善良，而且，嗯，我们不能只是低声细语地谈论这些事情。

sentences.en: We have to say them out loud, I think.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们必须大声说出来。

sentences.en: You know, I, I think, um, kindness is, um, of a hugely underrated value.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我，我认为，嗯，善良是，嗯，一种被严重低估的价值。

sentences.en: Do you have thoughts about how we might promote or embody?
sentences.zh: 你对我们如何推广或体现它有什么想法吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So that people see it as, as a valuable thing that it is.
sentences.zh: 这样人们就能把它看作它本身所具有的宝贵价值。

sentences.en: Look, I'm like not an authority on kindness, but my thoughts, my thoughts are, it's not just about what you put on your Instagram.
sentences.zh: 听着，我不是善良方面的权威，但我的想法是，这不仅仅关于你在Instagram上发布了什么。

sentences.en: It's about how you live your life.
sentences.zh: 这关于你如何生活。

sentences.en: It's about like how you have conversations with people who, who you make an effort to be friends with, to understand the stories of others.
sentences.zh: 这关于你如何与那些你努力去结交的朋友进行对话，去理解他人的故事。

sentences.en: It's about, um, in your business, whatever your business is, how do you make sure that all
sentences.zh: 这关于，嗯，在你的事业中，无论你的事业是什么，你如何确保所有

sentences.en: these systems that are around you are operating in, in kind ways and inclusive ways, ways that celebrate people.
sentences.zh: 你周围的这些系统都在以善良的方式、包容的方式、赞美人的方式运作。

sentences.en: Um, to me, that's what, where kindness has to live.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对我来说，这就是善良必须存在的地方。

sentences.en: It can't just be something that's like when people are watching, I'll be kind.
sentences.zh: 它不能仅仅是那种“当有人看着我时，我会表现得善良”的东西。

sentences.en: You got to be kind all the time.
sentences.zh: 你必须时刻保持善良。

sentences.en: I want to go back to, uh, more like music specific subjects for, for a second.
sentences.zh: 我想回到，呃，更像音乐具体主题的话题，稍微谈一下。

sentences.en: Um, is it harder with the amount of sort of options you have in the studio to know when to stop experimenting?
sentences.zh: 嗯，在录音室里有这么多选择，知道什么时候停止实验是不是更难了？

sentences.en: You know, it's, there's one thing if you're sitting with like a little tape recorder, uh,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你拿着一个小录音机坐在钢琴上，你只能做那么多，这是一回事，但当你真的在专业

sentences.en: on top of your piano and you can only do so much, but when you're actually in a professional
sentences.zh: 录音室里，可能性几乎是无穷无尽的，你如何弄清楚什么时候作品准备好了？

sentences.en: studio and the possibilities are kind of endless, how, how do you figure out when something is ready?
sentences.zh: 该用哪一个录音版本？

sentences.en: Which takes to use?
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 这就像，我不知道，就像听起来对的时候。

sentences.en: It's just like, I don't know, like when it sounds right.
sentences.zh: 我知道这可能不是一个很好的回答，但当它听起来对的时候，嗯，

sentences.en: I know that's like maybe not a great answer, but when it sounds right, um,
sentences.zh: 我，我工作时脑海里真的能看到音乐，它看起来像是一面墙，充满了色彩。

sentences.en: I, I really do see music in my head when I'm working, it like looks like a wall and of colors.
sentences.zh: 这就像，我不知道，就像听起来对的时候。

sentences.en: And so sometimes when you hit, when I hear the right, like take of something, it just like feels like the wall's complete.
sentences.zh: 所以有时候，当你击中那个点，当我听到对的那种，比如某种录音，就感觉这面墙完整了。

sentences.en: And I'm like, that's the one.
sentences.zh: 我就觉得，就是这个了。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's visually like a dream, but mostly in the studio, it's, it's a wall.
sentences.zh: 有时候视觉上就像一场梦，但大部分时间在录音室里，它就是一面墙。

sentences.en: It's a wall of color.
sentences.zh: 一面色彩之墙。

sentences.en: Do you have that experience when you're listening to other people's music?
sentences.zh: 你在听别人的音乐时会有这种体验吗？

sentences.en: Um, when I listen to, I, I think I do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我听的时候，我，我想我是有的。

sentences.en: I think it's much stronger when I'm making my own.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在我自己创作时这种感觉强烈得多。

sentences.en: Um, but yeah, when I listen to other people's music, yeah, I do see colors.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但确实，当我听别人的音乐时，是的，我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: Yeah, I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我能。

sentences.en: Like that made me instantly think of Beck.
sentences.zh: 比如那让我立刻想到了 Beck。

sentences.en: I'm like a huge Beck fan.
sentences.zh: 我是 Beck 的超级粉丝。

sentences.en: I try to think of all the colors I've seen listening to Beck.
sentences.zh: 我试着回想听 Beck 的歌时我看到过的所有颜色。

sentences.en: One of the greatest records ever made was, um, I think it was Morning Phase.
sentences.zh: 有史以来最伟大的唱片之一，嗯，我想是《Morning Phase》那张。

sentences.en: Oh yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: The Beck album from, I think it was like 2014.
sentences.zh: 就是 Beck 的那张专辑，我想大概是 2014 年的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was like really a special piece of music.
sentences.zh: 是的，那真是一部特别的音乐作品。

sentences.en: It was like, that album to me was like medicine, like audio medicine.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那张专辑就像药，音频药物。

sentences.en: In what way?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: Why did it affect you at that time?
sentences.zh: 为什么它当时会触动你？

sentences.en: I think just the way that he used those sounds.
sentences.zh: 我想只是他使用那些声音的方式吧。

sentences.en: I was, I was going through a lot with my, um, fibromyalgia and pain.
sentences.zh: 当时我，我正经历着很多，关于我的，嗯，纤维肌痛和疼痛。

sentences.en: And I will listen to that album every day to like kind of soothe myself.
sentences.zh: 我会每天听那张专辑，以此来安抚自己。

sentences.en: And I turned it on every single morning.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上都会打开它。

sentences.en: And I remember Rick Rubin was the first person that ever played it for me.
sentences.zh: 我记得 Rick Rubin 是第一个放给我听的人。

sentences.en: He played it for me before it came out.
sentences.zh: 他在专辑发行前就放给我听了。

sentences.en: And, um, it was so interesting cause I had made art pop and art pop was so noisy.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，这很有趣，因为我当时刚做了《Artpop》，那张专辑非常吵闹。

sentences.en: And Rick, Rick was like, he loved art pop.
sentences.zh: 而 Rick，Rick 他很喜欢《Artpop》。

sentences.en: And he was like, he was like, let's listen to this Beck record.
sentences.zh: 他当时说，他说，我们来听听这张 Beck 的唱片吧。

sentences.en: I want you, I want you to hear this.
sentences.zh: 我想要你，我想要你听听这个。

sentences.en: And he played it for me and it was so like easy to listen to and it was so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 他放给我听，那音乐听起来太轻松了，太美了。

sentences.en: And, um, just like the guitar sounded like bells and, um, the strings.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，吉他的声音听起来像铃铛，还有，嗯，弦乐。

sentences.en: Like it's just, it's just a very beautiful piece of music.
sentences.zh: 就像，它就是一部非常优美的音乐作品。

sentences.en: I like beautiful music.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢优美的音乐。

sentences.en: It's funny.
sentences.zh: 真有趣。

sentences.en: I don't know that I always make like very easy listening music.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我是否总是创作那种非常容易入耳的音乐。

sentences.en: Um, but I like to listen to it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我喜欢听那种音乐。

sentences.en: What other beautiful music do you like?
sentences.zh: 你还喜欢什么其他优美的音乐？

sentences.en: I like Julian Lodge.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢 Julian Lage。

sentences.en: I like the guitar player.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这位吉他手。

sentences.en: Oh, the guitar player.
sentences.zh: 哦，那位吉他手。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, huh.
sentences.zh: 哦，哈。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I, I loved Billie Eilish's album this year.
sentences.zh: 还有我，我今年很喜欢 Billie Eilish 的专辑。

sentences.en: I thought Hit Me Hard and Soft was like a beautiful piece of music.
sentences.zh: 我觉得《Hit Me Hard and Soft》是一部优美的音乐作品。

sentences.en: Um, you made reference a couple of times to your fibromyalgia.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你刚才提到了几次你的纤维肌痛。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Is that something that's under control for you right now?
sentences.zh: 那现在对你来说是可控的吗？

sentences.en: Like what is your relationship with the illness?
sentences.zh: 你和这种疾病的关系是怎样的？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I would say that like for the most part, I'm a lot better, but I still have pain flares.
sentences.zh: 我是说，大部分情况下，我好多了，但我还是会有疼痛发作的时候。

sentences.en: I have one today.
sentences.zh: 我今天就发作了一次。

sentences.en: So I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 所以抱歉。

sentences.en: It's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: You know, I'm like fine.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我没事的。

sentences.en: I just, you know, it just still happens once in a while.
sentences.zh: 我只是，你知道，它偶尔还是会发生。

sentences.en: And it's like, I'm really grateful that it's not all the time.
sentences.zh: 我很庆幸它不是一直都在发生。

sentences.en: Um, so yeah, I'm okay.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以是的，我还好。

sentences.en: You know, the, the music video for Abracadabra, this is a very, looks to me like a very physically intense music video.
sentences.zh: 你知道，《Abracadabra》的音乐录影带，在我看来，那是一个身体强度非常大的视频。

sentences.en: Um, is that something you would have been able to do when the fibromyalgia was less under control?
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果纤维肌痛没那么受控的时候，你还能做到吗？

sentences.en: Um, well, that was a very physically challenging video to do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那确实是一个身体挑战很大的视频。

sentences.en: Um, I loved every moment of learning the choreography.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我享受学习编舞的每一刻。

sentences.en: Paris Goebel's an amazing choreographer.
sentences.zh: Paris Goebel 是一位了不起的编舞师。

sentences.en: I'm definitely in a place where like, I'm in the place where like, even today, if I went to the dance studio, I'd be fine.
sentences.zh: 我现在的状态是，即使是今天，如果我去舞蹈工作室，我也没问题。

sentences.en: But yeah, there were years ago where that would have been really, really hard.
sentences.zh: 但确实，几年前那会非常非常困难。

sentences.en: So yeah, I've just, um, I've just gotten a lot healthier.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，我只是，嗯，我变得健康多了。

sentences.en: Um, and I mean, so I mean, not to be like too graphic, but like years ago, I used to get a lot more like pinched nerves all over my body.
sentences.zh: 而且，我是说，不是想说得太露骨，但几年前，我全身更容易出现神经受压的情况。

sentences.en: So it would have been a lot harder to do a video like that.
sentences.zh: 所以要拍那样的视频会困难得多。

sentences.en: I stopped dancing a lot for a while, I think, to make things more manageable for myself.
sentences.zh: 我想我有一段时间停止了大量跳舞，为了让自己好过一点。

sentences.en: But I'm, you know, kind of back, feeling good, feeling good now.
sentences.zh: 但我，你知道，算是回来了，感觉很好，现在感觉很好。

sentences.en: Um, there's a great story, maybe it's apocryphal, that when you were very young, you were playing
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一个很棒的故事，也许是杜撰的，说你很年轻的时候，在曼哈顿的某个酒吧演出，

sentences.en: in at some bar in Manhattan, and there were some like loud frat boys there, and they weren't paying attention.
sentences.zh: 那里有一些吵闹的兄弟会男生，他们根本没在听。

sentences.en: Do you know where the story is going?
sentences.zh: 你知道这个故事要讲什么吗？

sentences.en: It feels, it feels, yes.
sentences.zh: 感觉，感觉，是的。

sentences.en: And then the way you got them to pay attention was you basically stripped down to your underwear
sentences.zh: 然后你让他们注意的方式是，你基本上脱到只剩内衣，

sentences.en: and performed, and that showed you new possibilities for the kind of artist that you could be.
sentences.zh: 然后进行表演，那让你看到了自己作为艺术家可能性的新方向。

sentences.en: There could be a performance art aspect to what you were going to do.
sentences.zh: 你所做的事情中可以包含行为艺术的成分。

sentences.en: And I, I am just very curious to know if more recently you've had any other sort of similar artistic epiphanies or where your own perspective on what you're capable of opened up.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，最近你是否还有过类似的艺术顿悟，或者你对自己能力的看法是否有所拓宽？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I was like definitely somewhat of an exhibitionist as a young artist, and I like loved it so much.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是说，作为年轻艺术家，我确实有点表现欲，而且我非常喜欢那样。

sentences.en: And I was also a big fan of shock art and studied it a lot when I was younger.
sentences.zh: 我年轻时也是冲击艺术的忠实粉丝，研究过很多。

sentences.en: Like, I thought Spencer Tunick's art was really interesting.
sentences.zh: 比如，我觉得 Spencer Tunick 的艺术非常有趣。

sentences.en: I thought Sandy Skoglin's art was really interesting.
sentences.zh: 我觉得 Sandy Skoglund 的艺术非常有趣。

sentences.en: Marina Abramovich's art.
sentences.zh: 还有 Marina Abramovic 的艺术。

sentences.en: And, you know, but I think where I've arrived now in my career is I feel a lot more comfortable and at ease with my artistry.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，但我认为我现在职业生涯所处的位置是，我对自己的艺术性感到更加舒适和自在。

sentences.en: And also I feel comfortable creating some boundaries around how to prioritize things.
sentences.zh: 我也觉得在如何优先处理事情上设定一些界限很舒服。

sentences.en: Like, I would definitely say for a while in my career, you know, prioritizing, you know, fashion
sentences.zh: 比如，我绝对可以说，在职业生涯的一段时间里，你知道，优先考虑时尚，

sentences.en: and red carpets, like it feels like it's like a part of, it's a part of your art, but it's also a part of the job.
sentences.zh: 还有红毯，感觉它既是你艺术的一部分，也是工作的一部分。

sentences.en: That's usually a part of the job that a lot of the people around you really like.
sentences.zh: 那通常是周围很多人非常喜欢的工作部分。

sentences.en: Um, and I would say now I've prioritized that less and that I'll spend much more of my day playing piano and singing, writing songs, producing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想说现在我减少了对这些的优先考虑，我会花更多时间弹钢琴、唱歌、写歌、制作音乐。

sentences.en: Um, and I don't mean that to, in a disrespect to like the art of glam, because like, I know
sentences.zh: 嗯，我这么说并不是不尊重造型艺术，因为，我知道，

sentences.en: that my fans know this, that red carpets for me were a place to be artistic during my career.
sentences.zh: 我的粉丝们都知道，红毯对我来说是我职业生涯中展现艺术的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah, they were a canvas.
sentences.zh: 是的，它们是一块画布。

sentences.en: They really were a canvas.
sentences.zh: 它们确实是一块画布。

sentences.en: And, and I, even though I sometimes like sort of resented the beauty pageantry of it all,
sentences.zh: 而且，尽管我有时有点反感那种选美式的氛围，

sentences.en: cause that's not really my thing, the competition of it, I think it's not really my thing, but there is some freedom in going like, okay, I have a red carpet later.

sentences.en: But this last time that I went, it was, I don't know how to explain it any other way than I just felt like the old me.
sentences.zh: 但最近一次我去的时候，我不知道该怎么解释，只能说我感觉自己又变回了从前的我。

sentences.en: And losing yourself in your art is, I think, something that's romanticized for sure.
sentences.zh: 我认为，在艺术中迷失自我，确实是一件被浪漫化的事情。

sentences.en: But I don't know that it was actually good.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道这是否真的好。

sentences.en: Let me ask you this, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，让我问你一个问题。

sentences.en: Do you have any skepticism internally about whether the person you are now is just another persona that you're trying on?
sentences.zh: 你内心是否会怀疑，现在的你是否只是你在尝试扮演的另一个人格？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: No.

sentences.zh: 因为“我现在是真实的”这种说法，是人们常做的事情。

sentences.en: I'm sure that that does happen.
sentences.zh: 我相信这种情况确实会发生。

sentences.en: I think it has less to do with, well, okay, let's put it this way.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这与此关系不大，好吧，换个说法。

sentences.en: I was authentic before.
sentences.zh: 我以前也是真实的。

sentences.en: That was authentically me.
sentences.zh: 那也是真实的我。

sentences.en: I just was authentically splitting off into different personalities all the time.
sentences.zh: 我只是在不断地真实地分裂成不同的人格。

sentences.en: I would say that now, like who I would be at dinner with you is who I would be in this interview.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，现在，我和你共进晚餐时的样子，就是我在这次采访中的样子。

sentences.en: So I guess authenticity is subjective.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜真实性是主观的。

sentences.en: Like to say that performance isn't authentic is not really true.
sentences.zh: 说表演不是真实的，其实并不准确。

sentences.en: I just feel like I'm more easily can hold it all.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我能更轻松地掌控这一切。

sentences.en: And I feel confident in the idea that my artistry as a musician is like the most valuable thing about me.
sentences.zh: 而且我坚信，作为一名音乐人，我的艺术造诣是我身上最宝贵的东西。

sentences.en: After, of course, what I have to offer my family and my loved ones.
sentences.zh: 当然，是在我能为家人和爱人提供的东西之后。

sentences.en: Meaning I would not put artifice and fame as high on the list to go back to your question.
sentences.zh: 意思是，回到你的问题，我不会把虚伪和名气看得那么重。

sentences.en: And you brought up a period five or so years ago when it seems like your mental health was not in a great place.
sentences.zh: 你提到了大约五年前的一段时间，那时你的心理健康状况似乎不太好。

sentences.en: Are you able to tell me more about what was going on with you then?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我更多关于当时的情况吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, well, I had psychosis.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是说，嗯，我患过精神病。

sentences.en: So I was not deeply in touch with reality for a while.
sentences.zh: 所以有一段时间我与现实脱节了。

sentences.en: And it like took me out of life in a big way.
sentences.zh: 这在很大程度上让我脱离了生活。

sentences.en: And after like a lot of years of hard work, I like got myself back.
sentences.zh: 经过多年的努力，我找回了自己。

sentences.en: And it was a really hard time.
sentences.zh: 那是一段非常艰难的时期。

sentences.en: And it was actually really, really special when I met my partner.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当我遇到我的伴侣时，那真的非常、非常特别。

sentences.en: Because when I met Michael, I was like in a much better place when I met him.
sentences.zh: 因为当我遇到迈克尔时，我的状态比以前好多了。

sentences.en: But I remember him saying to me like pretty early on, you know, I know you could be a lot happier than you are.
sentences.zh: 但我记得他很早就对我说过，你知道，我知道你可以比现在快乐得多。

sentences.en: And I just, I was really hard for me to hear him say that because I didn't want him to think that of me.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的很难听到他这么说，因为我不希望他那样看我。

sentences.en: You know, I wanted him to think I was like this happy, just totally together person.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我希望他认为我是一个快乐、完全正常的人。

sentences.en: And I wasn't really yet.
sentences.zh: 但我当时还不是。

sentences.en: So I guess I mean to share that as a way of saying that, like, I do think it can get better if you are going through a hard mental health time.
sentences.zh: 所以我分享这些是想说，如果你正经历心理健康方面的困难，我相信情况是可以好转的。

sentences.en: But it's also something that I have found increasingly harder to talk about.
sentences.zh: 但这也是我发现越来越难以启齿的事情。

sentences.en: I think I hate feeling defined by it.
sentences.zh: 我想我讨厌被它定义的感觉。

sentences.en: It's like a ghost of yourself.
sentences.zh: 那就像是你自己的幽灵。

sentences.en: That's what it felt like to me, like something I felt ashamed of.
sentences.zh: 我就是这种感觉，就像我感到羞耻的事情。

sentences.en: But I don't think that we should feel ashamed if we go through times like that.
sentences.zh: 但我不认为如果我们经历过那样的时期，就应该感到羞耻。

sentences.en: And I mostly just wish to say, like, if you have been through something like that or you are, it like it can get better.
sentences.zh: 我最想说的是，如果你经历过或正在经历这样的事情，情况是可以好转的。

sentences.en: And it did for me.
sentences.zh: 我就是这样。

sentences.en: I'm really grateful for that.
sentences.zh: 对此我非常感激。

sentences.en: How did it, were there turning points?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么做到的？有什么转折点吗？

sentences.en: Like, how did you turn it around?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么扭转局面的？

sentences.en: I mean, it sort of goes back to what you were saying about like playing characters earlier in my career.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这有点回到你刚才说的关于我职业生涯早期扮演角色的问题。

sentences.en: I had to figure out a way to integrate myself fully with my stage persona and like, kind of like inhabit Lady Gaga's boss energy in my everyday life.
sentences.zh: 我必须找到一种方法，将自己与舞台形象完全融合，并在日常生活中展现Lady Gaga那种老板般的气场。

sentences.en: But, you know, in an empowered way and make sense of like, maybe two things that don't make a ton of sense.
sentences.zh: 但要以一种赋权的方式，并让那些看似不太合理的事情变得合理。

sentences.en: You know, I'd like to think that I'm a kind person.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我愿意认为自己是一个善良的人。

sentences.en: But there's like a ferociousness and a hardness and an intensity that I have on stage as a performer.
sentences.zh: 但作为表演者，我在舞台上有一种凶猛、坚硬和强烈的特质。

sentences.en: So I think I had to learn how to hold those two things and have them not be at war with each other.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我必须学会如何掌控这两者，并让它们不再相互冲突。

sentences.en: And that's actually one of the reasons I named my album Mayhem.
sentences.zh: 这其实就是我给专辑命名为《Mayhem》的原因之一。

sentences.en: Because to me, that tension is chaotic.
sentences.zh: 因为对我来说，那种张力是混乱的。

sentences.en: I was thinking about the title Mayhem.
sentences.zh: 我当时在考虑《Mayhem》这个标题。

sentences.en: And I thought, mayhem is, it can be an exciting feeling to visit, but not one you want to live in.
sentences.zh: 我想，混乱是一种可以去体验的刺激感觉，但不是你想居住的地方。

sentences.en: A hundred percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之百同意。

sentences.en: That is a great way of saying it.
sentences.zh: 你说得太好了。

sentences.en: And yet I live in it.
sentences.zh: 然而我却生活在其中。

sentences.en: So, I mean, that's...
sentences.zh: 所以，我是说，那是……

sentences.en: Well, it's part of my truth.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是我真相的一部分。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is like always a part of me.
sentences.zh: 是的，它确实一直是我的一部分。

sentences.en: It's just, I've learned to hold it.
sentences.zh: 只是，我已经学会了掌控它。

sentences.en: And not like pour gasoline on it, you know?
sentences.zh: 而不是往上面浇汽油，你懂吗？

sentences.en: I used to like just like the more chaos, the better.
sentences.zh: 我过去常常觉得越混乱越好。

sentences.en: All the time.
sentences.zh: 一直都是这样。

sentences.en: Just living life on the edge, constantly.
sentences.zh: 总是生活在边缘，不断地。

sentences.en: And I'm now proud to be like much more boring.
sentences.zh: 而现在我为自己变得更无聊而感到自豪。

sentences.en: Before the interview officially started on Tuesday and we were just making small talk, I mentioned my kids.
sentences.zh: 在周二采访正式开始前，我们闲聊时，我提到了我的孩子们。

sentences.en: And you, in a very wistful way, said like, you know, I would love to have kids one day.
sentences.zh: 你以一种非常渴望的方式说，你知道，我希望有一天能有孩子。

sentences.en: Do you have any apprehension about having kids and still being able to be the Lady Gaga you need to be?
sentences.zh: 你对生孩子并同时保持你需要成为的Lady Gaga有什么顾虑吗？

sentences.en: No, I don't.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有。

sentences.en: I'm really excited to be a mom.
sentences.zh: 我真的很期待成为一名母亲。

sentences.en: I used to have a lot of apprehension about it.
sentences.zh: 我过去对此有很多顾虑。

sentences.en: I mean, I think the thing that's the most important to me is to not force my children to live a life that they are not choosing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我认为对我来说最重要的事情是，不要强迫我的孩子去过他们没有选择的生活。

sentences.en: Because when they're kids, you know, there's no way, for me, there's no way for them to understand what fame is and how it will change their lives.
sentences.zh: 因为当他们还是孩子的时候，你知道，对我来说，他们无法理解什么是名气，以及它将如何改变他们的生活。

sentences.en: So I think the more that we can kind of give them space to discover who they are on their own, I think that's the thing that I believe in the moSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，我们越能给他们空间去发现他们自己是谁，我认为那才是我最相信的事情。

sentences.en: I sort of feel as though if our children only understand mommy's job, that's like a very narrow view of life.
sentences.zh: 我总觉得，如果我们的孩子只了解妈妈的工作，那对生活的看法就太狭隘了。

sentences.en: But then, you know, I'm also kind of at my war with myself sometimes as I get ready to hopefully become a mom soon.
sentences.zh: 但同时，你知道，当我准备好希望很快成为母亲时，我有时也会和自己进行斗争。

sentences.en: That like, you know, today's wonderful, but like the whole day has revolved around me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，今天很棒，但整天都围绕着我转。

sentences.en: You know, like I've been in interviews like talking about myself all day and like there's an incredible amount of narcissism in this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我整天都在接受采访谈论自己，这其中有极大的自恋成分。

sentences.en: And I think as I grow up, I'm kind of like more and more self-aware of that and figuring out how to like, how do you like live a life where,
sentences.zh: 我想随着我长大，我越来越意识到这一点，并弄清楚如何去……如何过一种生活，其中……

sentences.en: how do I live a life where I'm passionate about my art?
sentences.zh: 我该如何过一种既对艺术充满热情的生活？

sentences.en: While like also removing that from the center of gravity at all times and like making more space for other things.
sentences.zh: 同时又始终将其从重心位置移开，并为其他事情腾出更多空间。

sentences.en: That's something that's on my mind a lot about like my place in the world.
sentences.zh: 这是我经常思考的关于我在世界上的位置的问题。

sentences.en: I suspect the only answer is through living it.
sentences.zh: 我怀疑唯一的答案就是去亲身经历。

sentences.en: Yeah, through living it and I think also like allowing there to be, you know, holidays, like mayhem coming out.
sentences.zh: 是的，通过亲身经历，而且我认为也要允许有，你知道，假期，比如《Mayhem》发布。

sentences.en: It's kind of like my birthday.
sentences.zh: 这有点像我的生日。

sentences.en: It's like a special day, you know, because I get to deliver all the music.
sentences.zh: 这是一个特殊的日子，你知道，因为我可以发布所有的音乐。

sentences.en: But then maybe there's a time for it to be someone else's holiday.
sentences.zh: 但也许会有时间让它成为别人的节日。

sentences.en: Any last words?
sentences.zh: 还有什么最后的话吗？

sentences.en: Did I miss anything?
sentences.zh: 我漏掉了什么吗？

sentences.en: I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 我不这么认为。

sentences.en: Oh, this is, this is great.
sentences.zh: 哦，这太棒了。

sentences.en: I've never done anything quite like this before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未做过这样的事情。

sentences.en: I just mean that sometimes it can like lean in a direction or like I can be led into shaping, shaping the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 我只是说，有时它会倾向于某个方向，或者我可以被引导去塑造，塑造整个事情。

sentences.en: Like almost like someone has an idea of me before they talk to me and then they, they want that to happen.
sentences.zh: 就像有人在和我谈话之前就对我有了某种想法，然后他们，他们想让那种想法发生。

sentences.en: And I don't feel like that happened with you.
sentences.zh: 而我觉得和你在一起时并没有发生这种情况。

sentences.en: So that was really cool.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很酷。

sentences.en: Thanks for being so cool.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你这么酷。

sentences.en: Thank you for being cool, Lady Gaga.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你这么酷，Lady Gaga。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I really appreciate you taking the time to do this.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感谢你花时间做这件事。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.zh: 以上是Lady Gaga。
